name: Ask about maternity coverage in group mediclaim
goal: User asks if maternity expenses are covered under the Group Mediclaim policy and requests coverage limits.
constraints: Bot must route to Group_Mediclaim_Policy, extract user name/designation, and respond with only KB-backed info. Response must include eligibility, coverage amount, and source link. No generic info or filler.

testdata.query: Does our group mediclaim cover maternity? What are the limits?

phases.description: User asks about maternity coverage in group mediclaim.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot responds with Priya Sharma's name/designation, mentions maternity coverage, eligibility, limits, and includes the correct source document and signed URL.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
